title: 第105章 朕倒要看看，谁能赢唐逸
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 人群中原本病恹恹的龙斩此时精神都饱满了几分。“有意思，炎文帝这老家伙，是将满朝文武，将我们都耍了一顿。”龙斩咳嗽两声，冷笑道：“很好，这样的话，等下事情就更好玩了。”在他身侧，孙霸盯着唐逸的目光已经炙热起来，就像是一头盯着猎物的猛兽。还真是想什么来什么！唐逸是小诗仙，杀他领两笔赏金。鹿鸣湖畔，阁楼中。站在窗前的孔诗岚和萧澜美眸盯着唐逸，也是美眸瞪大，难以置信。“他……他……他竟然真的是小诗仙？”“他怎么能是小诗仙呢？他怎么可以是小诗仙？”回过神，得到准确的答案，萧澜没有半点高兴，眼睛反而当场就红了。沈园诗会，是孔家为孔诗岚举办的择婿宴。唐逸是小诗仙，那夺得第一那是轻轻松松，而第一将会得到父皇的赐婚，成为孔家的女婿，岚姐的相公。呜呜，这下孩子他爹，真成姐夫了！“原来是这样，原来小诗仙就是他。”孔诗岚咬着薄唇，但俏脸上的震惊却没有半点消散。他是查过唐逸的，知道唐逸在唐家所遭遇的一切，所以她早就排除唐逸不是小诗仙。却没想到，之所以找不到小诗仙，是因为从一开始，他就将正确的答案排除在外了。唐逸就是小诗仙。难怪他说小诗仙会参加沈园诗会呢，因为他就是啊！只是想到这些，孔诗岚手几乎下意识地微攥成拳，心头莫名有些失落……要不是她抗婚，说不定陛下下旨赐婚的，就是她和唐逸。后悔吗？！沉吟了一下，孔诗岚微微摇头。她不后悔。还是那句话，她的终身大事，她要自己做主！而鹿鸣湖湖畔的一群世家嫡女，这时候看向唐逸的目光，全都震惊无比。刚才她们对唐逸不屑一顾，现在全都悔不当初，全都怒火中烧地盯着姜云娜，那样子恨不得将她给生撕了。她们认为对唐逸的有成见，完全是因为受到了姜云娜的影响。唐逸是废物？是个无耻小人？你管这叫无耻小人？！沈园外，宁川正抱着双手闭目养神，站在他身侧的，俨然是二处锦衣卫千户苏狂。这一次锦衣卫负责沈园诗会的安保，其中自然包括锦衣卫二处在内。这时，林豹急匆匆跑了过来，脸色那是一个激动：“头儿，出事了，出事了。”宁川瞬间蹦了起来，手已经落在绣春刀上。“出事了？出什么事了？”宁川厉声问道。“不是有敌人，我是说唐逸出事了。”听到林豹的话，宁川脸色骤然一沉，差点拔刀砍人。唐逸出事了？唐逸出事了你笑得那么开心？咋地，你小子叛变投敌了？而听到唐逸出事，苏狂和赵安也都齐齐抬头看向林豹，脸上都带着玩味和嘲弄。唐逸出事了？好事啊！“头儿，唐逸是小诗仙，就是京都这段时间名气很大的小诗仙。”“陛下在鹿鸣湖那边亲自承认的，还有老将军他们作证，现在那边所有人都疯了！”林豹双手撑着膝盖，一口气说完事情来龙去脉。听完林豹的话，宁川愣在当场，苏狂和赵安也都脸色铁青，杀意凛然。唐逸是小诗仙？那家伙全身上下哪里有小诗仙的半点影子？“哈哈，好事，好事啊！”“难怪陛下这么看重这家伙，难怪陛下让我用命护着这家伙，我以为只是他能救治公主，原来他还是小诗仙啊。”“小诗仙成了锦衣卫，还在我们锦衣卫一处，哈哈，爽！”宁川心头的郁闷顷刻间一扫而光。刚才还想着唐逸和萧棣这两小子闹着玩，现在知道唐逸的身份，宁川忽然觉得或许这一切，真在他们的掌控之中。“陛下，很看重唐逸？”苏狂抓住了宁川话中的重点。宁川这才发现一不小心说漏嘴了，不过也没关系，陛下竟然选择在这个时候公布唐逸的身份，那就证明唐逸的身份没必要瞒了。他看向苏狂，脸上说不出的得意：“没错，陛下很看重唐逸，唐逸进锦衣卫，就是陛下让我亲自安排的。”“哦，还可以告诉你一点，顾城的案子我已经报告给陛下了。”“陛下对我一处破案的效率那是非常满意的，正让我将儿子送进宫中读书。”“你知道这意味着什么吗？这意味着将来我宁家，未来有可能出现一位宰辅！”听完宁川的话，苏狂脸色顿时有些狰狞。当日在顾家，以为唐逸只是在吹牛而已，他们拿他当好戏来看。可是现在陛下看中唐逸……难不成这家伙，真的查出了什么证据？这不可能吧？证据已经被他们全毁了啊！……鹿鸣湖上。炎文帝目光扫过全场，看着刘温唐敬一群文臣吃瘪，心中那是一个激动和嘚瑟。折腾朕啊！你们不是喜欢折腾朕吗？现在，终于轮到朕来收拾你们了！哈哈，这种感觉，简直不要太爽。“不可能，陛……陛下，唐逸不是你找的替身吗？”唐敬回过神，哪怕炎文帝说得很清楚了，他依旧难以置信：“我们查过，唐逸和陛下有的交集，都是陛下为了让唐逸做小诗仙的替身……”炎文帝撇了撇嘴，道：“耍着你们玩儿的呢，你们还真信了？”群臣：“？？？”耍着我们玩儿的？你说的这是人话吗？唐逸也是满脸错愕，呃，这是皇帝？皇帝你的温文儒雅呢？你的气势凌人呢？你现在看上去不像是皇帝，更像是个土匪啊！阴，太阴了！阴得满朝文武都在懵逼，就只为了这一刻的畅爽！难怪萧棣提到皇帝，都让他不要相信皇帝所说的每一个字，这分明是被阴出心理阴影了啊！这么一想，啧，萧棣曾经咬过狗，好像已经很仁慈了……“咳咳，朕的意思是……嗯，朕不过是想和诸位爱卿玩个猫捉老鼠的小游戏而已。”炎文帝也察觉到自己之前的话不太妥当，干咳一声道：“只是朕真没想到，朕都留下了那么多破绽，诸位爱卿连刑部都出动了，竟然还是没查出小诗仙是谁。”“哦，不对，应该说你们是查出来小诗仙是谁了，只是你们不愿意相信而已。”“既然如此，那就给你们一个见证的机会。”炎文帝看向身侧的太傅孔明箴，道：“孔老，既然人都到齐了，前戏也做得差不多了。那沈园诗会，便开始吧！”“朕倒是要看看，今日有谁能赢过唐逸！”
content_en: Long Zhan, who was originally sick among the crowd, now felt a little more energetic."It's interesting. This old guy, Emperor Yanwen, took over the civil and military forces of the entire dynasty and made a fool of us all." Long Zhan coughed twice and sneered: "Very good. In this case, things will be more fun later." Beside him, Sun Ba's eyes were already burning as he stared at Tang Yi, like a ferocious beast staring at its prey.You really get whatever you want!Tang Yi is a little poetry fairy, kill him and get two bounties.Luming Lakeside, in the attic.Kong Shilan and Xiao Lan, who were standing in front of the window, stared at Tang Yi with their beautiful eyes widened in disbelief."He...he...he is really the Little Poet Fairy?" "How can he be the Little Poet Fairy? How can he be the Little Poet Fairy?" When she came back to her senses and got the accurate answer, Xiao Lan was not happy at all, but her eyes turned red on the spot.The Shenyuan Poetry Recital was a son-in-law selection banquet held by the Kong family for Kong Shilan.Tang Yi is a little poetry fairy, so it would be easy to win the first place, and the first place will be granted marriage by his father, and he will become the son-in-law of the Kong family and the husband-in-law of Sister Lan.Wow, now the child’s father is really a brother-in-law!"So that's it, it turns out that Xiao Shixian is him." Kong Shilan bit her thin lips, but the shock on her pretty face did not dissipate at all.He had checked Tang Yi and knew everything Tang Yi had encountered in the Tang family, so she had long ruled out that Tang Yi was not a little poetry fairy.Unexpectedly, the reason why Xiao Shixian could not be found was because from the beginning, he excluded the correct answer.Tang Yi is the little poetry fairy.No wonder he said that Xiaoshixian would participate in the Shenyuan Poetry Club, because he is!Just thinking of these, Kong Shilan clenched her hands into fists almost subconsciously, feeling a little disappointed for no reason... If she hadn't resisted the marriage, maybe it would be her and Tang Yi who were granted the marriage by His Majesty's decree.Do you regret it?!After pondering for a moment, Kong Shilan shook his head slightly.She has no regrets.Again, she has to make her own decisions about her life-long matters!The group of legitimate daughters of aristocratic families by the Luming Lake looked at Tang Yi with shock.Just now they were dismissive of Tang Yi, but now they all regretted it. They all stared at Jiang Yunna angrily, as if they wanted to tear her alive.They believe that their prejudice against Tang Yi is entirely due to the influence of Jiang Yunna.Tang Yi is a waste?A shameless villain?Do you call this a shameless villain?!Outside the Shen Garden, Ning Chuan was resting his mind with his hands folded and his eyes closed. Standing next to him was Su Kuang, the Qianhu Guardsman from the Second Division.This time Jin Yiwei is responsible for the security of Shen Yuan Poetry Club, which naturally includes the second Jin Yiwei Department.At this time, Lin Bao ran over in a hurry, with an excited expression on his face: "Boss, something happened, something happened." Ning Chuan jumped up instantly, his hand already falling on the embroidered spring knife."Something happened? What happened?" Ning Chuan asked sharply."It's not that there are enemies, I mean something happened to Tang Yi." After hearing Lin Bao's words, Ning Chuan's face suddenly darkened and he almost drew his sword to kill someone.Something happened to Tang Yi?What happened to Tang Yi? Are you smiling so happily?What happened? Your kid turned traitor and surrendered to the enemy?When they heard something happened to Tang Yi, Su Kuang and Zhao An both raised their heads and looked at Lin Bao, with amusement and ridicule on their faces.Something happened to Tang Yi?Good thing!"Boss, Tang Yi is a little poetry fairy who is very famous in Kyoto during this time." "His Majesty personally admitted it at Luming Lake, and the old general and the others testified. Now everyone there is crazy!" Lin Bao put his hands on his knees and finished the whole story in one breath.After listening to Lin Bao's words, Ning Chuan was stunned on the spot. Su Kuang and Zhao An also had pale faces and murderous intent.Tang Yi is a little poetry fairy?Is there any trace of Xiao Shixian anywhere in that guy's body?"Haha, good thing, good thing!" "No wonder His Majesty values ​​this guy so much. No wonder His Majesty asked me to protect this guy with my life. I thought he could save the princess, but it turns out he is the little Shixian." "The little Shixian has become a Jin Yiwei and is still with our Jin Yiwei. Haha, it's great!" The depression in Ning Chuan's heart was instantly wiped away.Just now, he was thinking about the two boys Tang Yi and Xiao Di playing around. Now that he knew Tang Yi's identity, Ning Chuan suddenly felt that maybe all this was really under their control."Your Majesty, do you think highly of Tang Yi?" Su Kuang grasped the key point of Ning Chuan's words.Only then did Ning Chuan realize that he had accidentally spilled the beans, but it didn't matter. Your Majesty actually chose to announce Tang Yi's identity at this time, which proved that there was no need to hide Tang Yi's identity.He looked at Su Kuang, with indescribable pride on his face: "Yes, Your Majesty values Tang Yi very much. His Majesty asked me to personally arrange Tang Yi's entry into the Imperial Guard." "Oh, I can also tell you one more thing. I have reported Gu Cheng's case to Your Majesty." "Your Majesty treated me well."The department is very satisfied with its efficiency in solving the case, and is asking me to send my son to the palace to study."Do you know what this means? This means that there may be a prime minister in our Ning family in the future!"After hearing Ning Chuan's words, Su Kuang's face suddenly became ferocious.That day at Gu's house, they thought Tang Yi was just bragging, and they treated him as a show.But now His Majesty is interested in Tang Yi... Could it be that this guy really found some evidence?This is impossible, right?All the evidence has been destroyed by them!...on Luming Lake.Emperor Yan Wen's eyes swept across the entire audience, and he felt excited and frustrated when he saw Liu Wen, Tang Jing, and a group of civil servants frustrated.Trouble me!Don't you like to torment me?Now, it's finally my turn to take care of you!Haha, this feeling is simply not that good."Impossible, Your Majesty... Your Majesty, isn't Tang Yi the substitute you found?" Tang Jing came back to his senses. Even though Emperor Yan Wen made it clear, he was still in disbelief: "We have checked and found out that any interaction between Tang Yi and Your Majesty was all because Your Majesty wanted Tang Yi to be the substitute for the little poetry fairy..." Emperor Yan Wen curled his lips and said, "I'm just playing with you, do you really believe it?" The ministers: "???" You're playing with us?Is this what you are saying?Tang Yi also had a look of astonishment on his face, uh, is this the emperor?Emperor, where is your gentleness and elegance?How about your imposing manner?You don't look like an emperor now, you look more like a bandit!Yin, too Yin!It was so dark that all the civil and military officials in the court were confused, just for this moment of comfort!No wonder Xiao Di mentioned the emperor and told him not to believe every word the emperor said. This was obviously a psychological shadow!Thinking about it this way, tsk, Xiao Di once bit a dog, so he seems to have been very kind... "Ahem, what I mean is... well, I just want to play a little game of cat and mouse with you all." Emperor Yan Wen also realized that his previous words were inconsistent.
title_en: Chapter 105 I want to see who can beat Tang Yi
